name: Claudia Sheinbaum
role: President of Mexico (2024-present); head of government of Mexico City (2018-2023)
summary: Sheinbaum is a Morena politician and energy scientist who governs on an expansive state-led welfare and public-enterprise programme (Pemex and CFE as public companies, constitutionalised social programmes, rising minimum wage) alongside fiscal discipline, central-bank autonomy and openness to private investment. She backs popular election of judges, recall votes and a ban on re-election and nepotism, supports equal marriage and abortion rights and gender parity, and defends sovereignty and non-intervention while cooperating with the United States on security and trade.

universal-healthcare.rationale: Pledged free medical care, medicines and surgery for every Mexican from birth, consolidated IMSS-Bienestar and in 2026 began a universal health service.

raise-minimum-wage.rationale: Committed to raise the minimum wage from 1.6 to 2.5 food baskets and announced a 13% rise in December 2025.

markets-allocate-better.rationale: Called the neoliberal claims that the state should yield to market forces false, while still welcoming private investment in a mixed economy.

public-ownership.rationale: Her government made Pemex and CFE public state companies, guaranteed CFE at least 54% of generation, and restored passenger rail to the state; private investment remains in a minority role.

tax-the-wealthy.rationale: Promised no new taxes and no fiscal reform, and rejected an inheritance tax; she has not proposed higher taxes on the wealthy.

regulate-corporations.rationale: Ordered water concessions, required social security for app delivery workers and pledged separation of economic and political power.

cut-welfare.rationale: Kept every welfare programme, added new cash transfers and sent a reform to put them in the constitution.

legalize-drugs.rationale: In 2018 said personal opinion was regulation is better than prohibition (cannabis) and in 2021 backed not criminalising young consumers; has not spoken on other drugs as president.

state-harmful.rationale: Her whole programme expands state roles in welfare, energy, rail and health.

limit-guns.rationale: As head of government ran a voluntary gun buyback that collected over 6,500 weapons; as president she pressed the US to stop firearm smuggling into Mexico.

empower-police-military.rationale: Put the National Guard under the army, expanded the security secretariat powers and pledged soldiers pay no lower than the IMSS average wage.

same-sex-marriage.rationale: In 2022 celebrated state approval of equal marriage with the words "Amor es amor".

abortion-legal.rationale: Called abortion a right when Roe was overturned and celebrated the 2021 Supreme Court ruling and Mexico City legal abortion since 2007; as president says little directly.

correct-racial-injustice.rationale: Said she is settling historical debts to indigenous and Afro-Mexican peoples through the constitutional reform on their rights and justice plans.

preserve-national-culture.rationale: Promises to defend cultural heritage, historical memory, native languages and native corn as a core part of her Mexican Humanism.

humanitarian-intervention.rationale: Defends non-intervention and peaceful settlement and condemned US military action in Venezuela and Iran as contrary to international law.

drastic-climate-action.rationale: IPCC lead author; proposed a global reforestation fund at the G20 and set a 45% renewables goal for 2030, though her government also expands gas.

expand-nuclear.rationale: Said "No soy muy pronuclear" and ruled out new nuclear plants; Laguna Verde continues but will not grow.

experts-over-public.rationale: Made judges elected by popular vote and repeatedly says the people, not technocrats, should decide.

central-planning.rationale: Keeps a market economy with private investment (46% of electricity, Banxico autonomy) rather than central planning.

tax-inheritance.rationale: Said "no creemos que deba gravarse las herencias" and would not open the debate.

tariffs-protect-industry.rationale: Approved duties up to 50% on about 1,400 product lines from countries without a trade agreement, effective 2026.

state-directs-investment.rationale: Plan Mexico, Polos de Bienestar, state lithium, Plan Sonora and public rail and port investment channel investment into chosen sectors.

abolish-money-wages.rationale: Her policy centres on raising wages and the minimum wage within a monetary economy.

abolish-central-banks.rationale: Promised to respect the autonomy of the Bank of Mexico.

one-party-rule.rationale: Pledges all political freedoms and diversity, says "somos demócratas" and submits herself to a recall vote in 2027.

democracy-best.rationale: Says liberty is a democratic principle and justifies her reforms as letting the people decide.

direct-votes.rationale: Backs participatory democracy, popular consultations and recall; does not propose replacing representatives.

war-builds-character.rationale: Urged at the G20 to stop "sowing wars" and called spending on arms absurd next to poverty.

private-courts-defense.rationale: Expanded public security bodies, kept the army and Guard under state command and reformed the state judiciary.

ethnic-nation.rationale: Recognised the full rights of indigenous and Afro-Mexican peoples and declared "no al racismo".

equal-outcomes.rationale: Argues deepening inequality leads to injustice and made reducing it a governing aim ("primero los pobres").

indigenous-land-authority.rationale: Promised to implement the constitutional reform granting full rights to indigenous and Afro-Mexican peoples.

taxation-theft.rationale: Keeps and defends tax collection to fund welfare; says corruption control frees resources for public wellbeing.

individual-rights-only.rationale: Her government wrote collective rights of indigenous peoples into the constitution.

total-state.rationale: Pledged to guarantee freedoms of expression, press and assembly and called claims of authoritarianism false.

territorial-expansion.rationale: Foreign policy principles she stated: self-determination, non-intervention and peaceful settlement.

jewish-state-israel.rationale: Supports a two-state solution with a Palestinian state recognised alongside Israel; later called Israel's Gaza actions genocide.

school-vouchers.rationale: Her universal scholarships are tied to public schools and she is expanding public schools and universities.

avoid-deficit-stimulus.rationale: Pledged financial and fiscal discipline and a reasonable debt-to-GDP ratio.

rule-by-example.rationale: Says moral authority is what matters most and that rulers should live in just moderation.

national-self-determination.rationale: Names the free self-determination of peoples as a constitutional foreign policy principle.

force-without-un.rationale: Foreign policy stresses peaceful resolution and she objected to US strikes carried out outside international law.

work-for-welfare.rationale: Her pensions, scholarships and disability support are universal and carry no work requirement.

class-collaboration.rationale: Sets wages and the 40-hour week by agreement with employers and workers and stresses businesses and workers both gained.

sacrifice-heritage.rationale: Promotes cultural memory, arts, reading rooms and heritage recovery.

distinct-gender-roles.rationale: Created a Secretariat of Women, backs substantive equality in the constitution and paritary cabinets.

racial-segregation-law.rationale: Condemns racism, classism and machismo as a stated principle of government.

expand-fossil-fuels.rationale: Caps oil at 1.8 million barrels a day but plans to raise gas output sharply, add gas plants and consider modern fracking.

proportional-representation.rationale: Her 2026 electoral reform sought to cut proportional seats and remove them from the Senate; she said she personally disagrees with plurinominales.

national-mission.rationale: Her stated principle is non-intervention and self-determination; she does not promote exporting any system.

patriarchy-structural.rationale: Described women as long erased by history, declared a gender violence alert and legislates against structural discrimination.

political-elite-corrupt.rationale: Repeatedly denounces the previous "régimen de corrupción y privilegios", though she is herself part of the political elite.

security-forces-accountable.rationale: Decreed state responsibility for the 1968 Tlatelolco killings and pledged to find the Ayotzinapa students.

night-watchman-state.rationale: Her programmes give the state broad roles well beyond defence and justice.

discourage-race-mixing.rationale: Her stated platform opposes racism and discrimination.

equal-moral-worth.rationale: Said fraternity means "vernos a los ojos como iguales" and pledged to fight every form of discrimination.

consent-of-governed.rationale: Quotes Morelos that sovereignty comes from the people and repeats "con el pueblo todo".

diversity-weakens-cohesion.rationale: Praises Mexico's cultural mosaic and pledges to respect religious, cultural, political and sexual diversity.

emergency-suspend-protections.rationale: Said Mexico has no state of exception and the state would never be used to repress the people.

price-controls-essentials.rationale: Keeps price agreements for the basic food basket and capped gasoline and diesel prices by agreement.

party-controls-media.rationale: Pledged freedom of expression and the press as a government principle.

party-commands-army.rationale: Stresses the armed forces answer to a civilian commander-in-chief within the state.

unlimited-reelection.rationale: Sent a constitutional reform banning re-election for all elected posts from 2030.

recall-officials.rationale: Backs recall of mandate and promised to submit to a recall vote in 2027.

death-penalty.rationale: In 2018 said she opposes the death penalty because unjust trials would send innocents to death; she differs from the Green party on it.

minority-language-support.rationale: Pledged cultural rights and the promotion of indigenous languages.

restrict-freedoms-for-growth.rationale: Pledges to guarantee all freedoms while pursuing prosperity.

rich-countries-aid-poor.rationale: At the G20 proposed redirecting 1% of military spending to a fund for reforestation and poverty relief.

direct-election-head-of-state.rationale: Notes with approval that the executive is elected democratically.

central-bank-independence.rationale: Pledged to respect Banxico autonomy; has not endorsed a price-stability-only mandate.

precautionary-principle.rationale: Backs a constitutional ban on GM corn and said traditional fracking has environmental impacts, though she is now open to new fracking techniques.

courts-bound-by-majority.rationale: Rejected a Supreme Court bid to strike down the judicial reform and said the courts cannot review constitutional amendments.

gender-parity-bodies.rationale: Sent reforms requiring paritary cabinets in states and municipalities by law.

economic-self-sufficiency.rationale: Champions USMCA, nearshoring and trade with Latin America and the world rather than isolation.

civilizing-tutelage.rationale: Insists on self-determination of peoples and relations of respect, never subordination.

freedom-to-discriminate.rationale: Pledged to combat every form of discrimination.

animal-suffering-matters.rationale: Committed to support a constitutional reform recognising animal cruelty.

preserve-contested-monuments.rationale: Removed the Columbus statue from Paseo de la Reforma in 2021 as "decolonization".

paid-care-work.rationale: Launched a National Care System and cash support for women 60-64; she has not said care work should be wages.

arm-foreign-insurgents.rationale: Her foreign policy principle is non-intervention.

intervene-in-bloc.rationale: Stressed self-determination and non-intervention and denounced the US operation in Venezuela under UN Charter Article 2.

corporate-influence.rationale: First commitment: separate economic and political power and never submit to economic interests.

non-intervention.rationale: Cites non-intervention as a constitutional principle and invoked the UN Charter against US military action.

religious-nation.rationale: Pledged to respect religious diversity in society.

deference-to-leading-power.rationale: Says relations with the US are "cooperación sí, subordinación no".

defeat-communism.rationale: Kept close ties with Cuba, sent oil and aid, and kept the Cuban doctors agreement despite US pressure.

socialized-care.rationale: Began a progressive National Care System with public child-care centres.

criminalize-homosexuality.rationale: Celebrated equal marriage and pledged respect for sexual diversity.

suppress-opposition.rationale: Pledged political pluralism, freedom of assembly and no repression.

participatory-democracy.rationale: Plans an electoral reform to strengthen participatory democracy through consultations and recall.

divine-source-of-authority.rationale: Quotes Morelos that sovereignty flows from the people.

social-market-economy.rationale: Combines a market economy, private investment and fiscal discipline with broad social protection.

abolish-armed-forces.rationale: Strengthened the National Guard and the army role in security.

dynastic-succession.rationale: Proposed banning succession by direct relatives in elected posts and an end to nepotism.

wealth-concentration-endangers-liberty.rationale: Her first commitment is a separation between economic and political power.

abolish-police-prisons.rationale: Expanded police intelligence, investigation and detention powers.

charity-over-state-aid.rationale: Her programme is state programmes, constitutionalised, not charity.

term-limits.rationale: Proposed barring re-election for every elected office from 2030.

local-essentials-public.rationale: Says water belongs to the nation and builds public transport and public health services.

gm-crops.rationale: Said "No permitiremos la siembra de maíz transgénico" and backed a constitutional ban.

defensive-wars-only.rationale: Foreign policy of peaceful dispute resolution; urged an end to arms spending and wars.

future-generations.rationale: Says strong public energy firms should deliver clean energy for present and future generations and tied her G20 proposal to climate.

arms-reduction.rationale: Criticised soaring arms spending and proposed diverting 1% of it.

farm-price-support.rationale: Guaranteed prices (Precios de Garantía), Alimentación para el Bienestar purchases and credit for small farmers.

women-property-inheritance.rationale: Pledged agrarian rights recognition for over 150,000 women.

women-suffrage.rationale: First woman president; says women can hold the presidency and calls for equal participation.

gender-equality-agencies.rationale: Created the first Secretariat of Women.

extrajudicial-killing.rationale: Rejects a Calderon-style war on drugs and pledges human rights respect and never repressing the people.

protect-kin-minorities.rationale: Calls Mexican migrants in the US heroes and tasked the foreign ministry with defending them through consulates.

targeted-social-spending.rationale: Chose universal programmes (universal pension, universal scholarships).

no-business-privileges.rationale: Promises no tax forgiveness, no privileges and no influence peddling.

national-resource-control.rationale: Made Pemex and CFE public companies, pursues state lithium and declares water belongs to the nation.

patriotism-serves-workers.rationale: Her speeches combine "la patria" and Mexican humanism with a priority for the poor and working people.

notes: Living person: only record-based answers; nothing was inferred from party or label. Her energy stance has moved from a ban on fracking toward openness to new techniques (2026), and from "hugs not bullets" toward a harder line on organised crime; the recent position was used. Abortion and equal-marriage answers rest on her own earlier statements and tweets quoted in press; she says little on them as president. The Wikipedia pages are used for her record of enacted measures. gob.mx stenographic versions were blocked from this environment, so morning-conference quotes come via press reports.
